about_the_game:
In this retro-inspired RPG, you step into the worn-out shoes of a new employee at a modern IT service company. From day one, you sense something’s terribly wrong. The higher-ups make baffling, nonsensical decisions, the kind that could only be explained by sheer incompetence—or something far more sinister.

As you navigate the everyday absurdities of clueless middle management, ego-driven executives, and impossible customer demands, you begin to unravel a horrifying truth: A manipulative, Lovecraftian essence has taken hold of the company’s wealthy founders. Their greed and ambition have opened the door to madness, and now it’s up to you to survive the chaos and uncover the dark force pulling the strings.

Features:

  • A twisted tale of corporate horror wrapped in dark humor and absurdity.

  • Classic RPG visuals reminiscent of SNES-era classics.

  • Branching quests based on your chosen character class, with unique dialogue and solutions.

  • A freely explorable office complex filled with strange and unhinged characters.

  • Outside locations that take you to customer sites and event venues—where the madness follows.

  • Inspired by real-life consulting nightmares… with a deliciously over-the-top twist.

Are you ready to climb the corporate ladder, or will you fall into the abyss of madness?

The Only Thing Worse Than Management… Is What Controls It.
